name: Mysterious Mysticism
summary: Halea of Gelkis Village needs Greater Mystic Essences to enchant weapons for the Gelkis windchasers. You are asked to bring her three while keeping the Gelkis’ trust.

sections.title: Halea’s Need
sections.body: Halea in Gelkis Village salvages magical arms gathered from fallen adventurers. She turns their mysterious remnants toward enchanting weapons, especially those carried by the Gelkis windchasers. Now she needs Greater Mystic Essences to outfit the next raiding party.

faq.q: Who is asking for the essences?
faq.answer: Halea, who works with salvaged magical armaments in Gelkis Village, needs Greater Mystic Essences.

faq.q: Why does Halea need Greater Mystic Essences?
faq.answer: Halea needs them to enchant weapons for the Gelkis’ next raiding party, especially the windchasers’ arms.

faq.q: What does Halea do with salvaged weapons?
faq.answer: Halea cannot use the salvaged armaments directly, so she takes their magical remnants and uses them to enchant weapons.
Halea is in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

faq.q: How many Greater Mystic Essences does Halea need?
faq.answer: Halea asks for three Greater Mystic Essences.
